subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence transfer and initial reply playbook
messages:

Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter options

Hi Irene,

We're starting our vendor security intake for a Q3 audit and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and related materials to complete our assessment. Specifically:

- PDF of most recent SOC 2 Type II report (audit period + auditor name)
- If the report does not cover our requested audit window (Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026), a bridge letter or statement confirming controls in the gap period
- List of evidence artifacts you can provide (system diagrams, retention policy, incident logs, encryption details) and how you prefer to share them (S3 presigned, secure SharePoint, or secure transfer)
- Point of contact for evidence questions and a suggested delivery ETA (we're hoping to close by Apr 8)

If you have a short templated reply we can attach to our procurement packet (legal likes to see consistent wording), that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Sr. Information Security Analyst
Acme Analytics
security@acmeanalytics.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter options

Maya —

Thanks for the clear ask. Below is a concise package we can share immediately and a couple of transfer options. I copied Priyom (security liaison) and Hannah (audit lead) to coordinate evidence delivery.

What we'll share by default (attached / linkable):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf (audit period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31; auditor: BrightGate LLP)
- Bridge-letter-template.docx — if you need a signed attestation for any shorter coverage window
- Evidence index (high-level) + delivery options (see attached evidence-transfer-options.txt)

Preferred transfer methods (choose one):
1) Secure S3 presigned URLs (single-use links, 7-day expiry) — best for large artifacts
2) Encrypted SharePoint folder (customer-managed access) — good for cross-team access
3) Direct secure file transfer (SFTP with accounts) — if your procurement requires managed accounts

Suggested reply snippets you can paste into procurement: 
- "Redwood Inference has provided its SOC 2 Type II report (audit period 2026) and a bridge letter option for any coverage gaps. Evidence transfer is available via presigned S3 links or encrypted SharePoint; contact security@redwood.com for access."

ETA: We can deliver the SOC 2 PDF and bridge-letter draft within 24 hours of confirmation. Evidence index + access by EOD Mar 24 if S3/SharePoint is acceptable.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Roadmap.pdf (stub - roadmap & what we share), bridge-letter-template.docx, evidence-transfer-options.txt

—
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Evidence checklist & transfer plan for Acme Analytics (timeline = Apr 8)

Quick internal notes — please treat as internal-only.

Acme asked for SOC2 PDF + bridge letter + evidence. They want to close by Apr 8. Proposed plan:
- Priyom: prepare presigned S3 bundle (see list below) and generate single-use links. Set expiry to 7 days and restrict to Acme IPs if requested.
- Hannah: prepare evidence index and mark any items that are operationally sensitive (we will not include full raw logs; provide summaries and sampled extracts). Also confirm auditor letter wording for bridge-letter-template.docx.

Suggested evidence bundle (initial):
- System architecture diagram (redacted where needed)
- Data retention policy (retention_periods.pdf)
- Encryption at rest/in transit summary (encryption_summary.md)
- Incident response summary + recent incident timeline (incident_summary_redacted.pdf)
- Access control matrix (roles_and_permissions.xlsx) — provide access-level summary rather than full export

Security notes: avoid sharing full user-level audit logs. Provide hashed samples or aggregated summaries unless Acme's DPA requires otherwise. If they request raw logs, route through legal and approve an NDA + narrow scoping.

Please confirm ETA. I'll send the external reply once you confirm transfer method and link(s).

Thanks — Irene

From: Maya Patel <security@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter options

Irene / team —

Appreciate the quick response and the playbook. Please proceed with the S3 presigned bundle and send the links to security@acmeanalytics.com. Procurement will also need the bridge-letter-template.docx attached to the contract packet.

One ask from legal: if possible, include a one-paragraph statement confirming BrightGate LLP was the auditor for the 2026 engagement (we'll paste that into our vendor memo).

Target: we will review the materials internally by Apr 1 and aim to finalize by Apr 8. If anything changes, I will escalate.

Thanks,
Maya
